name: Claudia
title: Christian woman in Rome
summary: Claudia was a Christian woman in the church at Rome mentioned in Paul's second letter to Timothy. She was among the believers who sent greetings to Timothy through Paul. Her name suggests that she may have belonged to the Roman upper class or been a freed slave from the Claudius family.

keyEvents.title: Greeting to Timothy
keyEvents.description: Claudia is mentioned as one of the believers in Rome who sent their greetings to Timothy through Paul's letter. This shows that she was an active part of the Christian community in the imperial capital.
